svg.title: Link and ExternalLink
svg.desc: Three links: a head link "Completion report" in the text colour without an underline at rest; a link inside a sentence, underlined in the colour of the text; and an external link "Documentation" with the external-link glyph after it.
svg.text: a head link: underlined on hover
Read the completion report before you start again.
external: a new tab, said in its name
a link names its destination; never brand-coloured, never a button
